title: xw.replay-corpus-manifest.v1
description: Manifest for the M6 replay corpus. Every frame/evidence entry is content-addressed and must be deidentified, synthetic or explicitly authorized. The schema fixes the executable shape (no propertyNames/format/anyOf — the shared validator subset cannot enforce those); sensitive keys such as account/device/serial/token/cookie/secret/password/balance/credential are rejected by validateReplayCorpusManifest in m6-contracts.mjs via a recursive normalized key scan.

source.description: Provenance: capture pipeline or generator that produced the asset.

deidentified.description: Schema-level requirement: only deidentified assets may enter the corpus.

origin.description: Synthetic or captured under explicit authorization; nothing else is allowed.
